value.rationale: The concrete continuum-spectrum unitary sampling question has a sharp, complete answer separating discontinuous measurable identifiability from uniform C*-stable recovery. The exact 1/(2 Re lambda) barrier holds for every sample set, while the W* approximation distance has a precise common-alias-period phase transition, including the factorial-clock example where every finite stage fails and its union succeeds. This delineates a motivated operator-algebra boundary not a made-up numerical slice.
